This week brought steady progress on running LLM agents in production. Teams report fewer failures from better tooling, and new papers examine evaluation and cost.

## Tooling and reliability

- [Agent runtime released](https://example.org/a) - A new runtime adds retries and tracing for long-running agents.
- [Evaluation harness](https://example.org/b) - A harness replays production traces against new prompts.

## Research and costs

- [Cost study](https://example.org/c) - Caching cuts the cost of repeated tool calls.
- [Planning paper](https://example.org/d) - A planner reduces the number of model calls per task.
- [Postmortem](https://example.org/e) - An outage traced to an unbounded retry loop.
